title: Rayman
overview:
Discover the world of Rayman, where action, challenge and technology await you... 60 different levels in six amazing worlds! Eye-popping animations using 65000 colors!

Rayman is a side-scrolling platform game. The evil Mr. Dark has stolen the Great Protoon, and the tiny Electoons who keep Rayman's world in harmony have been scattered and caged. Guide the limbless hero through each stage, find the exit and smash the six hidden cages to free the Electoons. Betilla the Fairy grants new powers along the way, such as the Telescopic Fist that Rayman throws at enemies and comes back like a boomerang, so earlier stages can be revisited from the map to uncover cages you missed. Only when every cage is open can Rayman reach Mr. Dark.
